description: This header defines classes and functions for handling civil time representations (year, month, day, hour, minute, second) in the Abseil C++ library, including construction, normalization, comparison, arithmetic, formatting, parsing, and stream output of civil time objects.

classes.name: CivilSecond
classes.description: Civil time representation aligned to seconds, supporting construction, comparison, arithmetic, and formatting.

classes.name: CivilMinute
classes.description: Civil time representation aligned to minutes, supporting construction, comparison, arithmetic, and formatting.

classes.name: CivilHour
classes.description: Civil time representation aligned to hours, supporting construction, comparison, arithmetic, and formatting.

classes.name: CivilDay
classes.description: Civil time representation aligned to days, supporting construction, comparison, arithmetic, and formatting.

classes.name: CivilMonth
classes.description: Civil time representation aligned to months, supporting construction, comparison, arithmetic, and formatting.

classes.name: CivilYear
classes.description: Civil time representation aligned to years, supporting construction, comparison, arithmetic, and formatting.

methods.name: FormatCivilTime
methods.description: Formats civil time objects into string representations based on their type.

methods.name: ParseCivilTime
methods.description: Parses string representations into civil time objects, with strict format matching.

methods.name: ParseLenientCivilTime
methods.description: Parses string representations into civil time objects, allowing more flexible formats.

methods.name: AbslParseFlag
methods.description: Parses command-line flag strings into civil time objects.

methods.name: AbslUnparseFlag
methods.description: Converts civil time objects into command-line flag string representations.

methods.name: GetWeekday
methods.description: Returns the weekday for a given civil time.

methods.name: NextWeekday
methods.description: Returns the next civil day that falls on a specified weekday.

methods.name: PrevWeekday
methods.description: Returns the previous civil day that falls on a specified weekday.

methods.name: GetYearDay
methods.description: Returns the day of the year for a given civil time.
